paragraphs.label: E-1
paragraphs.text: Let us pray. Our heavenly Father, we approach Thee in the Name of the Lord Jesus.

paragraphs.label: E-2
paragraphs.text: And now, Lord, as we open Thy Word, we pray that the Holy Spirit will reveal it.
Now, the Rapture is made up of three things: a shout, a voice, and a trumpet.
The shout is the Message going forth first, the gathering-together time.
